page_title: LEC 0-0 ROM | Lecce v AS Roma 01/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' AS Roma fail to score from a corner as Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce) leaps to collect the ball.
90+5' What a great effort! Remi Oudin (Lecce) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches over the crossbar. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
90+3' Lameck Banda (Lecce) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
90' Lecce are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
89' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
89' A player from Lecce commits a rough challenge. Matteo Marcenaro blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
86' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
86' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lecce will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
86' Lameck Banda (Lecce) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Mile Svilar stops the ball from going into the top of the net.
85' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and can count himself very lucky that the referee didn't issue a red card.
84' Daniele De Rossi decides to make a substitution. Tommaso Baldanzi will be replaced by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma).
84' Daniele De Rossi has decided to make a change. Zeki Celik (AS Roma) replaces Rick Karsdorp.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lorenzo Venuti (Lecce) comes onto the pitch so that Antonino Gallo can be given a rest.
81' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
81' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matteo Marcenaro had an easy-decision to make.

78' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Wladimiro Falcone is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
77' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
75' AS Roma are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
74' Angelino (AS Roma) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Wladimiro Falcone, who smothers the ball.
73' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lecce.
73' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
72' The substitution has been made. Remi Oudin (Lecce) has replaced Patrick Dorgu.
71' AS Roma fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
71' Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Wladimiro Falcone is alert and denies him.
70' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mile Svilar intercepts the ball.
69' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) latches on to a sweet cross into the box and misses with a header way wide of the left post.
68' Nikola Krstovic provides the assist in the box, but Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) places his shot a fraction wide of the right post.
67' The game is interrupted as Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) is flagged offside.
66' Angelino (AS Roma) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
64' Substitution. Nicola Zalewski did his best and is replaced by Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma).
64' It is time for a substitution. Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) is on for Edoardo Bove.
62' Substitution. Roberto Piccoli leaves the pitch and is replaced by Nicola Sansone (Lecce).
61' Luca Gotti prepares a substitution. Pontus Almqvist is replaced by Lameck Banda (Lecce).

60' Ambitious effort from Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the right post.
59' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) is able to continue to play.
57' A corner kick by Lecce is thwarted by the well prepared Mile Svilar (AS Roma).
56' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
55' Wow, what an escape. Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
55' PENALTY APPEAL by AS Roma, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
55' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) takes the corner.
54' The AS Roma players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
51' 17:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
48' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Daniele De Rossi probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Evan Ndicka. He is replaced by Dean Huijsen (AS Roma).
46' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
45+1' Angelino (AS Roma) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the left post! A few inches to the right and it could have been a sweet goal!
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) was quite harsh and Matteo Marcenaro didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
42' The ball falls kindly for Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just over the bar.
41' Looks like Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
40' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
38' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) has tested the patience of referee Matteo Marcenaro and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
35' A lofted cross from Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
33' Mile Svilar pulls off a great save to deny Patrick Dorgu (Lecce), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
31' A long pass finds Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
30' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
29' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Antonino Gallo (Lecce), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
28' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
28' The opposition back off Antonino Gallo (Lecce) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky!
27' Romelu Lukaku almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
25' One of the players from Lecce times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
23' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
23' The corner from Antonino Gallo (Lecce) is hurriedly cleared.
22' What a chance that is! Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
21' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:2.
19' The AS Roma players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
17' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) jumps for a header from the resulting set piece, but it goes way wide of the right post.
17' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
16' The resulting corner from Antonino Gallo (Lecce) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
16' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) fires a powerful shot which is blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Lecce are awarded a corner kick.
15' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) tries to get on the end of a cross in a crowded box, but under pressure his header from near the penalty spot slips well wide of the right post.
14' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lecce, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
13' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) commits a rough foul. Matteo Marcenaro stops the game and makes a call.
12' Lecce couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Mile Svilar (AS Roma) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
12' Matteo Marcenaro shows a yellow card to Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) for his blatant foul.
11' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.
8' Marin Pongracic (Lecce) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
8' It will be a corner kick for Lecce.
7' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
5' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
2' Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
AS Roma will kick-off.
Matteo Marcenaro got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
